stories.title: Deepak Parekh highlights lack of official housing‑starts data in India
stories.summary: At the Data Users Conference, Deepak Parekh said India does not have official housing‑starts statistics, a metric he described as closely linked to many allied industries. He also noted the recent revision of the GDP base year to 2022‑23 and its impact on interpreting economic indicators, and urged the use of high‑frequency data to supplement quarterly GDP figures.
stories.why: Official housing‑starts data would enable better monitoring of construction activity and its spill‑over effects on the wider economy.

stories.title: Amazon to acquire Decart’s AI optimization technology for $7.5 billion
stories.summary: Amazon announced a $7.5 billion deal to buy Decart, acquiring the Decart Optimization Stack (DOS) that enables AI models to run more efficiently on Nvidia, Amazon and Google hardware. The purchase also includes Decart’s founding team and its AI researchers and engineers. Decart is known for interactive real‑time world‑model projects such as Oasis 3 and AI video‑generation tools.
stories.why: The acquisition adds cross‑hardware AI optimization software to Amazon’s portfolio, strengthening its AI cloud and chip offerings.

stories.title: RBI Governor urges NBFCs and housing finance firms to strengthen cyber defences
stories.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra called on non‑banking finance companies and housing finance companies to strengthen their cybersecurity measures. He emphasized a comprehensive, risk‑based approach to managing cyber threats and stressed the need for responsible credit growth and customer prioritisation. Participants also exchanged feedback on policy and operational issues affecting the NBFC sector.

stories.title: S&P forecasts 7% GDP growth for India in FY27, warns El Nino costs
stories.summary: S&P Global projects India's gross domestic product will expand by 7% in fiscal year 2027, placing the country among the fastest‑growing economies in the Asia‑Pacific region. The agency also cautions that the anticipated El Nino weather event could add economic burdens.
stories.why: The forecast highlights strong growth potential while flagging a climate‑related risk that could affect policymakers and investors.
